claim_ceiling: Total roasted content is not extractable inventory or c_s0.
No runtime inventory provider, OpenFOAM execution, governing-physics change, Angeloni reuse, SCI-MD-006 reopening, G0 work, predictor adoption, or experimental commissioning is authorized.

f4_semantics.categorical: Distinct eligible material-roast units by required pure species and nonempty harmonized category; qualifying strata meet both unit and validation-group thresholds.
f4_semantics.decision: F4 passes when either the complete categorical route or complete quantitative route passes.
f4_semantics.quantitative: Distinct eligible material-roast units with nonempty metric type, finite value, and required units; metric types are never converted or pooled.
f4_semantics.within_species_varying_group: For one required species, a validation group qualifies when at least two distinct eligible material-roast units share one nonempty metric type and contain at least two distinct finite values; count each group at most once per species.

f7_semantics.decision: F7 passes iff outer validation groups meet the frozen threshold and publication, data-lineage, and base-material leakage computed from actual folds are all zero.
f7_semantics.leakage: For each held-out group, preserve train/test intersections of publication ID, data-lineage ID, and base-material ID and aggregate their distinct counts.

independent_review_requirement: One reviewer independent of implementation must review exact frozen producer and consumer candidates after terminal green CI.

allowed: Deterministically derivable corrections to existing search bookkeeping recorded in R2_REGISTER_CORRECTIONS.csv
prohibited: new or removed numeric observation, material, or roast realization
changed eligibility, evidence class, rights status, lineage linkage, or validation-group linkage

scientific_disposition.compound_formula: F0 and F1 and F2 and F3 and F4 and F6 and F7

rules: Exactly one log row per contract-derived query/provider search ID and no extras.
Result rows reconcile counts, bindings, contiguous ranks, dates, terminal states, and canonical candidate roots.
Duplicate lineages have exactly one canonical introduction; links terminate without dangling references, multiple roots, duplicate-only lineages, or cycles.
Each atlas source has one bounded completed backward and forward citation pass; absence is not zero-result completion.

artifact_consistency.required: Result, export, gates, summaries, observation register, R2 search/fold audits, and source-package manifest must reconcile semantically and byte-deterministically.
